objs.name: document
objs.description: Core managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions that go through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycles.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix with consecutive number identifying the document.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid the document belongs to.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking revisions of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_extension_period
attributes.description: Period after which the document must be reviewed for continued validity (default 3 years).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language in which the document content is maintained or translated.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original office format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related master data, IT applications, or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or clients for which the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-controlled document object added to a main document, not subject to a formal release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional info has been directly published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal suggesting changes to an existing released document, managed and tracked within the document cockpit.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring review and decision on continued validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate (put out of force) a document, triggering the archiving workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring it to an editable state.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, translator).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role(s) assigned to the user (e.g., Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution lists for documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type or purpose of the user group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Whether distribution is by email notification or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that drives approval, validity extension, override, or reactivation steps with assigned participants.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature recorded for each workflow step participant, documented per released version for traceability.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which the signature was applied.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was recorded.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new documents with TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Office format of the template (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific view presenting relevant documents, tasks, and evaluation reports to a user.

attributes.name: dashboard_type
attributes.description: Type of dashboard (e.g., Reader Document List, Author overview).

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report providing filtered listings and status information about documents in the system.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g., Status Report, Document Monitoring, Acknowledgement Status).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Criteria used to filter the report results.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Company organizational entity (department, location) to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing and management.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Tenant or company entity in a multi-client system where document visibility and local additions are managed.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format and displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The author or co-author initiates the 3-step release workflow (Creator, Review, Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first Creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling subsequent tasks.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment's content is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Previously archived attachments are restored during document reactivation.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is added to a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is removed from a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights user creates a change proposal for a released document without affecting its content or version.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the resolution of a change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) processes the validity extension request through a workflow.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's validity is confirmed and the valid-until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates an override request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow by releaser (and optionally initiator, reviewer).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; its last released version is archived and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a reactivation request for an invalidated document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation request workflow is executed by the initiator to restore the document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated with a new version, restoring metadata, authorizations, and distribution settings.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list receive an email notification about the new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list receive a workflow task to actively confirm acknowledgement of the document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is reviewed and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or pending actions.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive duration expires, an archived document is physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An attachment is a controlled sub-document that belongs to a specific main document.
Additional info is supplementary information attached to a specific main document.
A change proposal is created for and linked to a specific released document.
A validity extension request is generated for and linked to a specific document approaching expiry.
An override request is created for a specific document to initiate its invalidation.
A reactivation request references a specific invalidated document to be reactivated.
A document can reference another document (e.g., local client additions referencing the original).
A document is created based on a defined document template for its document type.
A document can be linked to a business process for process-specific filing.
A document can be linked to an organizational unit for targeted storage.
A document's visibility can be configured per client in a multi-client system.
A distribution list is maintained per document to define notification and acknowledgement recipients.
A distribution list includes user groups whose members receive distribution.
A distribution list can include individual persons as direct recipients.
A user is assigned to one or more user groups that grant specific roles and authorizations.
